Honestly, that would be nice — if it's clearly the same page and only some tracking bits or a jump-to-a-section marker got tacked on the end, I'd love it to recognize that and take me back to the bookmark I already have rather than making a near-duplicate.

That said, I don't want to overcomplicate things. My main worry is the plain case of saving the exact same link twice, which we've already handled well. This tidier matching is a welcome bonus rather than something I'd hold the app up for — I'd trust your judgment on how far to take it, as long as it errs on the safe side and doesn't wrongly merge two genuinely different pages.
